articles.summary: Grows revenue 25% year-over-year to $218.1 million Delivers net income of $18.2 million and grows Adjusted EBITDA 41% year-over-year Exceeds Q3 guidance and delivers record results on all key metrics Issues strong Q4 outlook indicating ongoing positive momentum and demand CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - EverQuote, Inc. (Nasdaq: EVER), a leading provider of growth solutions for property and casualty, or PC, insurance providers, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “We are generating record results across our key financial metrics as we successfully grow and deepen our relationships with our carrier and agent customers,” said Jayme Mendal, Chief Executive Officer of EverQuote. “Carriers continue to maintain strong underwriting profitability and an appetite for growth, and our team is executing seamlessly to meet this demand. articles.title: EverQuote Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
